svg.title: Buccal graft placement interfaces
svg.desc: Dorsal onlay places the graft against a tunical bed. Ventral onlay uses spongiosal support and coverage. Asopa dorsal inlay reaches the dorsal bed through ventral access. The blue graft is directly apposed to its bed. Panels show simplified graft–bed interfaces, not complete operative cross-sections. The figure does not establish a universally preferred graft side. View: Anterior bulbar urethra, simplified transverse interfaces; dorsal up. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: Barbagli: bulbar urethroplasty using the dorsal approach (2003 technical article), https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15745501/; access: abstract checked; Dorsal graft placement on the corporal tunical bed; no survey preference percentage used. Dorsal inlay buccal mucosal graft (Asopa) urethroplasty (2015 technical article), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4708270/; access: full-text access inconsistent; Ventral approach to a dorsal graft bed; initial indexed text available, later PMC request returned a browser challenge. Recheck full operative figures before sign-off. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Buccal graft placement: show contact with the supporting bed
Simplified graft–bed interfaces; dorsal is up in every panel. Not a complete operative cross-section.
Dorsal opening; graft on tunical bed
Blue = graft; short brown lines = fixation. Bed contact supports take; no universal preferred side.
